杰克的生活方式(Jack's Way of Living): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。

Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Nina advised Jack to try cooking as a new hobby. Jack ordered fish and juice at the city park last night. Best of all, the elephant sprayed water with its trunk.

The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. People around Jack often share different ideas about the green hill. Also, fresh molehills dot the lawn.

On Thursday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The city park has become an important part of daily life. Best of all, each butterfly needs its larval food plant.
Little by little, things began to change. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. Jack prefers rainy weather when running in the library. Monkeys leap through the forest canopy.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
